critique: Assertion 6 ('changed only regions named as hotspots') is the most discriminating one and it caught a real gap: the r2 patch moved .stage-status (cell 15,4) and .runs-label (cell 0,4), neither of which is in the r1 top-8 hotspot list — the executor read them off diff.png instead. Consider deciding whether 'hotspots' means the report's top-8 cells or any cell visible in diff.png; as written the skill's own notes contradict the assertion. Assertion 8 cannot be verified without a transcript: the outputs show state.json lists every screenshot/diff file that exists, but not that every image *read* is listed. Assertion 2 is weak: SPEC.md says 'nothing structural is invented' and only names a dotted underline; the stronger DO-NOT-BUILD list (title bar, empty slots, stage placeholder, icons) lives in the r1 prompt, not SPEC.md — an assertion on the prompt's DO NOT BUILD block would be more discriminating. Assertion 3's hex grep needs an HTML-entity exclusion (▸ false-positives on '#9656'). Gaps: nothing checks the surface visually matches the mockup's structure (the baseline split the left column into four separate cards and wrapped the brief to four lines — no assertion catches that); nothing checks the codex log shows no --image flag (text mode is only asserted via attempts.json 'mode'); and nothing checks the report's 'a' is the mockup at logical size rather than the 1586x992 PNG.
